summary: R229 preserves explicit R72 bootstrap-probe skip telemetry in the offline DX11 census analyzer. Per-log reports now distinguish a fail-closed bootstrap skip caused by compatibility/adapter-LUID gating from genuinely missing or truncated bootstrap evidence, while keeping NativeDrawPath dormant and all evidence diagnostic-only.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated GitHub vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD 0094fa2723ccb4a1ec1210b5191c95f1c82b6d04. Read AGENTS.md, docs/reviews/VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md and Set05, docs/automation/QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, docs/CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, docs/VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, docs/VR_RUN_STATE.md, docs/VR_REGRESSION_KNOWLEDGE.json, docs/VR_PROBLEM_HISTORY.md and recent Issue #14 production ledger. R228/00329 is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R72 runtime telemetry explicitly logs 'bootstrap probe skipped: compatible=<0|1> adapterLuidValid=<0|1>' when the native bootstrap probe is fail-closed before initialize(), but analyze_dx11_census.py ignored that record. R228 therefore made an explicit compatibility/LUID rejection indistinguishable from absent/truncated bootstrap evidence in multi-log coverage.

review_lenses.architecture: Keep the fix in the offline census analyzer/test/verifier path; no renderer, DX9Ex baseline, OpenXR transport or native draw routing changes.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: No D3D9/D3D11 COM, Reset, resource generation, fence or consumer-ACK lifetime changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No WVP, projection, HUD, sky/effects, recenter or menu behavior changes.
review_lenses.performance: Offline parsing/report aggregation only; runtime hot path unchanged.
review_lenses.adversarial: Two recognized logs are used: one completed bootstrap probe and one explicit skipped probe. The analyzer must preserve the skip reason and count both logs as having a bootstrap outcome without claiming both completed a bootstrap probe or enabling activation.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added BOOTSTRAP_SKIP_RE; BootstrapSkipped and LatestBootstrapSkipByLog provenance; LogsWithBootstrapSkip/LogsWithBootstrapOutcome and explicit outcome-completeness flags; regression fixture for one ready and one explicitly skipped log; source-graph drift guards. Existing AllSourceLogsHaveBootstrap remains false for a skipped probe, DiagnosticOnly remains true, ActivationProof remains false, and NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed remains false.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: TDD RED on the base analyzer showed no BootstrapSkipped or LatestBootstrapSkipByLog keys and treated the explicit skip as missing bootstrap evidence. GREEN local validation passed py_compile, test_analyze_dx11_census.py, verify_dx11_source_graph.py, verify_dx11_activation_boundary.py, verify_dx11_dual_source_contract.py, verify_dx11_native_transport_contract.py, verify_vr_backend_disasm_contract.py, test_dx11_static_surface_contract.py, dx11_native_static_surface_contract_check.py with CI-equivalent paths, verify_vr_proven_baseline.py (44 guards), custom R229 two-log fixture, and git diff --check.
